name: mcp-eda
description: MCP server for AI-native IC design. Bridges AI agents to real EDA tools (Yosys, OpenROAD, KLayout, SymbiYosys, Magic, ...) and lab hardware (FPGA programmer, oscilloscope, USB tester) over the Model Context Protocol. ~30 tools across synthesis, simulation, place-and-route, sign-off, and device I/O. Reference hardware: Keysight DSO-X 3014T, Terasic DE10-Lite, USB-HID tester.
